crossRefs.note: If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.
subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of…
not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God…
Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

translations.web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
translations.bsb: So the angel of the LORD told her, “Return to your mistress and submit to her authority.”
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
